facts: Creates a new owned transport root and bare input Git repository; rejects existing/symlink root and staging paths and symlink parent ancestry. Prior partial upload fragments are neither reused nor removed.

Concrete root-bound supply commit/tree are checked after fetch. Each supplied manifest/member is bound by exact tree path/blob, byte length, SHA256, and Git blob hash. Strict base64 and ordered offsets precede full gzip/raw request verification.

Root authorization and original idempotency key are checked before publication; the supplied loader is compared with the enabled core request expected_loader. Local loader is byte-identical to the frozen V3 loader. Small-control bytes are bound by the root-pinned supply manifest.

Publication uses a newly created fsynced owned file and same-filesystem os.link, which fails if the final staging name exists. Only that invocation-owned temporary name is unlinked after success; final staging nlink and full bytes are checked again.

Unchanged V3 loader is invoked only after complete input verification; its full stdout/stderr remain the durable outer job streams. Loader exit is propagated and bootstrap terminal evidence is saved on success or failure.
No product source/target/index mutation is performed by this bootstrap before handing off to the separately authorized original V3 loader.
limits: This review did not bind or execute a concrete supply commit/tree, invoke Git/network on a native host, or run product tests.

The original disabled 738-byte small control remains historical; an enabled control necessarily has a concrete execution guard and corresponding exact identity. No claim of byte equality to the disabled control.
Current transport command success, provider durability, available capacity, and actual unchanged V3 execution remain runtime gates; source-only review does not qualify them.
Existing authorized Git authentication is used through normal Git by the later owner; this reviewer did not read credentials or inspect unknown native jobs.
